decisive_items: finger was larger than the others since birth
overgrowth of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges
response.rationale: Macrodactyly is congenital digital overgrowth, often with fatty infiltration; CT confirms lipomatous change without vascular abnormality, excluding hemangioma. Neurofibroma lacks skin findings or neurofibromatosis stigmata.

rejected.why: No neurofibroma stigmata; sensory changes are secondary to nerve compression from overgrowth
CT shows no abnormal vascular structures, contradicting a hemangioma component
